options: None of the above. Uttarakhand Assistant Prof. (GDC)- 2017
optionsEn: None of the above. Uttarakhand Assistant Prof. (GDC)- 2017
questions.explanation: The process of shifting the monetary burden of tax from the ultimate taxpayer to the payer is called tax deferral. According to Musgrave, "In traditional usage, tax devolution refers to the process by which a direct monetary burden is passed from the point of taxation to the point of stoppage by adjustment of value". According to Professor Bhargava, "Difference of tax can take place only through the process of exchange, that is, the divergence will happen only when the taxed goods are sold and bought". Tax diversions are generally of three types- 1. Shifting through price 2. Forward and Backward tax shifting 3. Tax Capitalization.

questions.questionText: The most important small scale industry in India is -
questions.questionTextEn: The most important small scale industry in India is -
questions.explanation: The most important small scale industry is handloom industry in India. Textile and Jute industries are large industries while handloom is small industry. There different boards are established in first five year plane. (i) All India handloom board (October 1952) (ii) All India handicraft board (November 1952) (iii) All India Khadi and village industries commission (1956) Thus, handloom is important small scale industry in India.
